subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel preference and XML sample request
messages:
From: Sara Lane <sara.lane@clearpayables.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@clearpayables.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: invoicing channel & sample file for Redwood

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. As we start vendor setup for ClearPayables, finance asked me to confirm the preferred invoice intake method and any required schema fields. We usually send invoices via XML (we can also do CSV/EDI or portal upload). I attached a representative sample (sample_invoice.xml).

Quick questions:
- Do you prefer vendors to upload invoices through your vendor portal or continue emailing to a billing address?
- If email is ok as a fallback, do you require PO stamping in the subject/filename or inside the XML?
- Do you have an XSD or field-spec we should follow (PO number, tax id, remit address, line-level unit price & commodity codes)?

We can adapt the payload quickly if you share the required fields and a sample XSD. Goal is to avoid repeated OCR/manual corrections.

Thanks,
Sara Lane
Head of Finance Operations
ClearPayables Inc.
(sara.lane@clearpayables.com)
Attachment: sample_invoice.xml (XML, 12KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lane <sara.lane@clearpayables.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: invoicing channel & sample file for Redwood

Sara — thanks for the sample and the clear questions. High level from procurement: we prefer portal onboarding for new vendors (single source of truth + easier PO matching), but we accept emailed XML as a fallback during the onboarding window. A few specifics to design for: 

Must-haves in the invoice header:
- PO number (single field; we match exactly to our PO header)
- Redwood vendor ID (we'll issue when onboarding is complete)
- Invoice date & invoice number
- Total amount & currency

Line-level: description, qty, unit price, line tax (if applicable).

Operational notes:
- If emailing PDFs, include PO in both subject and filename (e.g. PO123456_invoice.pdf) — PDFs are high-effort for us.
- For XML/CSV: include a flat PONumber field in the header (not nested under misc).
- We have an onboarding packet and vendor form with mandatory fields — I'm attaching the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf. Please fill and return so we can provision the portal account + vendor ID.

Ben (cc) — finance questions: can we accept emailed XML to billing@redwood-invoices.com during the first 30 days of onboarding, or do you want a shorter window? Also any constraints on SFTP vs API?

Onboarding form: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

Thanks — I'll hold for your filled form and any XSD you have.

-Karthik
Director, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Sara Lane <sara.lane@clearpayables.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: invoicing channel & sample file for Redwood

Adding finance requirements here. Hi Sara — welcome. A couple of items from AP/Finance: 

1) PO-match policy: We require the PO number on every invoice for automated routing. If PO missing, the invoice will be held and require manual remediation with your AR team.
2) Remittance: include remit-to name, address, and banking instructions if ACH/IBAN are used.
3) Tax/TIN: include vendor tax ID on header.
4) File format preferences: XML (preferred) > CSV > PDF. For XML, we can accept SFTP drop or secured API inbound. If you plan SFTP, we will provide credentials once the onboarding form is returned and vendor ID is issued.

Fallback email acceptance: we will accept emailed XML to billing@redwood-invoices.com for a 14-day onboarding window, then require portal/API/SFTP. Please ensure subject includes the PO number.

If you have an XSD, attach it and we'll validate; otherwise, send a sample XML and we'll give quick feedback. Typical failure modes we've seen: nested PO fields, missing currency tag, and PDF-only attachments with poor OCR.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Sara Lane <sara.lane@clearpayables.com>

- Populate and return the onboarding form by EOD Monday (please confirm where to upload — the Drive link works but if there's a secure upload preference let us know).
- Adjust our XML to include a flat <PONumber> header element and vendorTaxID in the header.
- Start with emailed XML to billing@redwood-invoices.com as a 14-day fallback while we complete portal provisioning.

Questions:
1) Do you provide an XSD or should we send an updated sample payload for validation?
2) For SFTP access, who should we expect credentials from (procurement or ops)?
3) Proposed go-live: once form is returned, can we aim for portal access within 7 business days?

Attaching an updated sample payload for quick validation: clearpayables_sample_payload.xml. If you can run it through your validator and confirm fields that still need changes, that would speed things up.

Best,
Sara

ClearPayables Inc.
